sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the open-weights frontier model from Z.ai, released August 26, 2026 under the MIT license. It matches Claude Opus 4.8 on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index with a 1,310,720-token context window, native text, image, and video input, and a 320B-parameter MoE that activates only 18B.
